summary:
Short version: the GDN counters of section 10 are built as one commit on top of the base commit (8 files, 1,640 added lines, 6 removed). It builds on delphi-3b35 and all unit tests that exist in that tree pass. I did not run runtron, so the wiring inside model::state is compiled but not executed.

What was built (paths under /home/jhan/workspace/ai-runs/tron-gdn-stats):
- h/tron/models/gdn_stats.hpp (new, 754 lines), namespace tron::gdn_stats, Note [GDN path stats] at line 7. The fixed interface is unchanged: gdn_path, N_PATHS_3, PATH_NAMES at 126-128, work_tally at 174-198.
- Switch TRON_GDN_STATS: env_enabled() at 151. Same rule and warning style as TRON_ATTN_STATS.
- Rows: worker_op_row (203), one per (class, worker, operation), 17 atomics, 192 bytes. Walls: op_timers (241). Forward record: forward_counters (251). Facts: header_facts (263).
- model_stats (299): note_gdn_job (399), end_forward with the wall fold (418), sums (488-516), JSON rendering (521-631), print_report (635). forward_scope (684). register_fuse_files (718).
- h/tron/models/gdn_execution.hpp: new last parameter at line 99. The one bool test is at 124. Stamps at 125, 146, 157, 161, 164, 174. Tally update at 165-172. note_gdn_job call at 176. The TRACE_EVENT is unchanged.
- h/tron/models/model.hpp: member gdn_path_stats at 1372. Construction and FUSE registration at 1733-1754, under if constexpr (!gdn_operations.empty()). Forward scope at 2144-2160.
- ingest/src/TronCpp.hs:3140 and 3146: gdnExecutionCall passes outer_state.gdn_path_stats.get().
- README.stats.md: paragraph and key list at 300-354, one path-table row, one registration-site clause.
- t/CMakeLists.txt:266-272: t_gdn_stats.cpp is the second FILES entry of t_gated_delta_net.
- t/t_gdn_stats.cpp (new, 10 cases, tag [gdn_stats]) and one hook case at t/t_gated_delta_net.cpp:2293.

Design decisions and deviations from the brief:
- The totals leaf and the totals line also carry wall_cycles, wall_max_cycles and wall_count (sum, largest, count over the operations). The brief listed these keys per operation only. The worker leaf does not carry them.
- n_gdn_workers_min and n_gdn_workers_max record the n_workers argument of run_gdn_operation, not the number of workers that had work. active_workers in the summary counts workers with at least one job.
- The GDN forward scope is declared before the attention scope. So the attention forward wall (T1) does not include the fold of the GDN stamps. The GDN forward wall is therefore not taken from literally the same stamps as T1.
- model_stats takes 5 constructor arguments. n_operations comes from header_facts.n_operations.
- note_gdn_job takes one struct (gdn_job) with named fields plus the tally, and is marked noinline to keep its code out of run_gdn_operation.
- Per-forward stamps are stored 4 per cache line, in whole lines per worker. The fold reads and clears them in end_forward (one pass), not in begin_forward.
- Added helpers that the other engineers can use: path_ix(gdn_path), stamp_if(bool), BLOCK_TOKENS_32.
- header_facts.block_tokens is set from gdn_stats::BLOCK_TOKENS_32 in model.hpp. The geometry facts come from gdn_kernels[0] only.

Check that the hooks did not change the kernel code: in runtron of the base tree and of this commit, the 48 GDN symbols outside run_gdn_operation have the same names and sizes except model::state::forward (1,304 to 1,514 bytes) and three perfetto lambdas whose names contain the changed signature. The body of run_gdn_operation for operation 0 grew from 3,993 to 4,598 bytes: 6 rdtsc and 1 more call. Its counts of vfmadd, vmulps and vaddps instructions are equal (32, 8, 12).

not_done: runtron was not run (rule of the task). So the code in model::state was compiled into runtron but never executed by me: the construction of gdn_path_stats, the FUSE registration for a real state, the forward_scope in forward(), and the report of a real run.
t_generate_mock_plugin is not generated in the one-model tree. It is the only unit test that runs model::state::forward with GDN operations and the generated GDN scheduler. Not built, not run.
fourmolu is not installed on agentsrv or delphi-3b35. The 3 changed lines of ingest/src/TronCpp.hs were formatted by hand. The generator compiled and produced the expected call.
config/test-benchmarks.json was not refreshed with bin/slice bench (t/AGENTS.md asks for it after a test change). No new test target was added, so no new row is needed.
The time cost of the hooks was not measured, neither with the switch on nor off. Insufficient data: an A/B run of the base build against this commit with TRON_GDN_STATS unset and set would give it.
The whole-repository lint (make lint with clang-format-19 over all files) was not run. Only the 5 touched C++ files were checked.
The campaign recipe was not changed (TRON_GDN_STATS=1 in the run environment, a [gdn-stats] parser). That is item 10 of section 10 and outside this task.
risks: Deviation: the totals leaf and the totals line carry 3 keys more than the brief lists (wall_cycles, wall_max_cycles, wall_count). A parser that expects exactly 17 keys in totals must allow them.
n_gdn_workers_min/max record the n_workers argument of run_gdn_operation. With more workers than work items they are larger than the number of workers that had work.
The GDN forward wall is not taken from the same stamps as the attention T1. The GDN scope is the outer one, so its wall is longer than T1 by the begin and end work of the attention scope.

Off state per run_gdn_operation call: one pointer test, one byte load, and a zero fill of the 136-byte stack tally. No rdtsc, no atomic. The zero fill is per call, not per token, and matches the attention precedent of one stack tally.
On state, forward thread: end_forward reads and clears n_workers x n_operations stamp slots per forward (56 x 24 = 1,344 slots, 21.5 KB for this model on 3b35). Cost not measured.
The GDN wall compares raw TSC stamps of different cores. Measured offsets on 3b35 are within 46 cycles (reader report). On another machine the error can be larger.
The summary geometry comes from gdn_kernels[0] only. A plugin with several GDN kernels shows the first one.
header_facts.block_tokens is set from gdn_stats::BLOCK_TOKENS_32. The AMX kernel commit should tie it to the kernel's own constant, and must set amx_gdn_enabled at model.hpp:1736-1741.
The chain-path commit must move the token-path accounting at gdn_execution.hpp:165-172 into the token branch. Otherwise chain tokens are counted twice.
gdn_stats.hpp holds inline functions and includes spdlog and the FUSE headers. A translation unit with AMX compile flags should not include it.
The switch test forks children that call spdlog::warn. This is the pattern of assertion_signal, but a child can hang if another thread holds a logging lock at fork time. It did not happen in 5 runs.
The unit tests print 81 [gdn-stats] lines to stderr, two of them very long (128 operations). The attention tests print the same kind of lines.
